notes.title: NubiaPhobia Will Soon Launch!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

My comedy/horror point & click adventure game, NubiaPhobia, will be available in about two weeks!

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33016994/a0edd6541df956c6ea7d80264e566f6e8edd3106.jpg[/img]

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AJW8Wq-CDB4

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3570040/NubiaPhobia/

Please go check it out. It has a demo live now. I hope you like it. If you do so, remember that a wishlist goes a long way.

It took me almost a year to make the game. In that year, I found some free time while the background images were being illustrated. So I spent some of my spare time making another game: FORMIDO.

It is a visually very dark, horror walking simulator that focuses on the story and atmosphere. It also has a demo for you to try.

FORMIDO will be released on Steam, on a very near date to NubiaPhobia, so it would be a great idea to check it out as well. ːdpgmixː

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OpGbc7ba-ZA

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3913230/FORMIDO/

Both NubiaPhobia and FORMIDO are great games, and I hope you'll enjoy playing them as much as I did making them.

Game on,
Tonguç

notes.title: The Redress of Mira - Dev Diary
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

My development on The Redress of Mira is going on steady with maximum love and attention to detail.

As I mentioned in the previous post, it will offer a longer time to play than my previous games, therefore it is taking longer to make. Plus the large amount and variety of game mechanics are also extending the development phase even further. I am thankful to all of you for your patience and support.

Starting to make an empty level from scratch is making me need too much caffeine, while getting near the end of it, making small tweaks, and adding nice details is a more relaxing and -to me- fun job. So The Redress of Mira is a cycle of each of these states of mind as a whole game. I think I'm proud of what I did so far on this one.

As there are still so many things left to do on this project, the game's release date is currently not clear. BUT I have a fancy date in my mind like 11.11.22. However, there is some chance it can be earlier than that. I'll keep you guys updated as I make progress.

I am loving to make this game, and I work hard on it. To prove to you how much different it is from my past works, and to give you some idea about the visual side of it, here's a shot from one of its cutscenes (It is WIP and subject to change):

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33016994/f8fceb0282b314d0060779dff9e83623b237fcda.jpg[/img]

Take care y'all!
Tonguç

notes.title: My Next Game
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

I have been heavily working on my next game for some months. Its name is "The Redress of Mira". As many of you requested, it has a rich and profound story. Just arranging it, making it parallel with the gameplay took me a very long time.

The game will feature some fantasy elements along with eye-candy nature vistas. I received some feedback about some of my previous games being shorter than expected so this next one will offer a longer gameplay duration; maybe about four times longer than Cions of Vega for example. Or maybe about three times longer than Nephise: Ascension?

But the gameplay won't be just forever walking on a path. It will offer a high variety of interactions at every corner.

I'll try my best to finish development and release it in 2022, that's all I can say for now.

Anyway, I'm going back to development now but before I go, here's a teaser of the game:

https://youtu.be/AHKPKhLRvsc
Hope you enjoy it.

Stay safe, my friends! =)
Tonguç

notes.title: Big Update
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,
After nearly 3 years I have made some cool enhancements on Nephise Begins!
[list]
[*] First I have migrated the project to Unreal's latest version. With that I have added a [b]compass system[/b] to the game so the player will notice whenever there is a skull to collect nearby, and going to see its direction.
[*] Another thing I did is adding [b]volumetric fog[/b] to the game so the lighting is better now. Also with the help of the volumetric fog, the mushrooms that you'll want to collect are better visible from mid-distance due to the red light the emit.
[*] I did some small fix in the game's code.
[*] I made some enhancements in the game's UI so it looks more proper.
[*] I have removed tessellation from the landscape so now the game should run smoother.
[*] Finally I have removed the unrealistic fur from the fox and replaced it with a [b]better looking[/b] one.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28542996/e26b40c65ed452fe74b900e42784b13e6a6174ae.png[/img]

Hope you enjoy the game, and in case you're on the fence to buying it, maybe it is time you give it a try since it is overall a [b]better experience[/b] with this update.

Game on! ːdpeagleiaː
Tonguç

Note: If you happen to play the game with the version [b]before this update[/b], all you have to do is go to game properties, under the Betas tab select "before big update".

notes.title: Third Nephise Game Now Available!
notes.notes:
Nephise: Ascension, the third game in the Nephise series, has just been released!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/803150/Nephise_Ascension/
Join Nephise in her longest and most dangerous adventure so far, with a richer story than previous Nephise games thanks to the involvement of Bottle: Pilgrim writer Michael Bowser.

This also promises to be Tonguc Bodur’s most interactive game to date, with more puzzles and even some light “platforming” elements added to the mix.

A brand-new adventure awaits!

[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/914665966095226203/8DFB304DDBFD3CAFB8FABEA88CEC1FBFC7E05F57/[/img]
